verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item explicitly states that RunAnywhere's SDKs or CLI can load/run GGUF-format model files; docs only speak generically about 'detecting the format the model expects' and downloading models, without naming GGUF, quantization formats, or compatibility with llama.cpp-style GGUF files (the llama.cpp fallback mention in comm-13 refers to an inference engine, not a confirmed GGUF-loading capability).
